No check measuring THIS rebuild fails: parity 287/287 at 100.0% recall, fabrication SOURCED, decontamination CLEAN, sweep 0 blocker/major introduced, hero worst-case contrast 8.74 measured from rendered pixels. See docs/CHANGE-LOG.md section 3.
